notes:
REF-BM-02: Automatically collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable only after saving, not before.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, tags, and note are editable, but URL is not.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate saves are prevented and the existing card is highlighted, but editing is not opened or directly initiated.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but use a generated initial tile rather than a favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: Search treats input as plain text, so #tag syntax is unsupported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and operator-literal rules are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is unsupported.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are always ordered by creation date; no selectable sort key is provided.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
